subject.title: Text between tool calls leaks to messaging channels

question: Should external channel sessions keep automatic bare-text replies by default, or should they move to an explicit message-tool or final-only delivery policy to prevent inter-tool text leaks?
rationale: Current code and docs preserve automatic visible replies for normal direct/group/channel turns, while the safest leak fix likely changes compatibility-sensitive channel delivery behavior.

options.title: Change external channels to explicit delivery
options.body: Move external source replies toward message-tool-only or final-only semantics with migration, doctor, docs, and proof coverage so internal text does not reach chats by default.

options.title: Keep compatibility and add opt-in guards
options.body: Keep automatic replies as the default, but land targeted guards such as enforce-final or stricter verbose-off/message-tool-only handling for users who opt in.

options.title: Split by surface
options.body: Apply explicit delivery to shared rooms and cron first while preserving direct-chat automatic replies until a separate migration is ready.

recommendation.title: Change external channels to explicit delivery
recommendation.body: Move external source replies toward message-tool-only or final-only semantics with migration, doctor, docs, and proof coverage so internal text does not reach chats by default.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-file blame and recent commentary leak fixes make this the clearest routing owner for the delivery-policy decision.
